skip_reason: Backend and frontend services not running — static analysis only

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection — 7 CVEs (CVSS 8.1–9.8)
escalations.description: Handlebars ≤4.7.8 contains 7 distinct JS injection vulnerabilities including AST type confusion, prototype pollution, and missing validation. As a transitive dependency in Source/Backend, an attacker who can influence template inputs could execute arbitrary code.
escalations.exploit_scenario: If any user-controlled string reaches a Handlebars template render call, prototype pollution or AST injection allows arbitrary code execution in the Node process.
escalations.recommendation: Identify which direct dependency pulls in handlebars (npm ls handlebars in Source/Backend); upgrade that package or add a forced resolution to handlebars >=4.7.9.

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution — 11 CVEs (CVSS up to 9.8)
escalations.description: Protobufjs ≤7.6.2 contains 11 CVEs including remote code execution, code injection, and DoS vectors. Pulled in transitively through @grpc/grpc-js, which is used by the gRPC communication layer of the orchestrator and portal backend.
escalations.exploit_scenario: A malicious gRPC message containing crafted protobuf data can trigger RCE in the orchestrator process. The orchestrator is the core infrastructure managing all agent pipelines.
escalations.recommendation: Update @grpc/grpc-js to >=1.15.0 in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend to pull in a fixed protobufjs version.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search route not registered in app.ts — DependencyPicker broken in production
p1_findings.description: The search route handler exists and has tests, but is never wired into the Express app. The DependencyPicker typeahead component silently fails in production because all search requests return 404.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any user navigating to a work item detail page and attempting to add a dependency will see an empty picker with no results — the feature is completely broken.
p1_findings.impact: P1 functional regression — core dependency management feature non-operational
p1_findings.recommendation: Add `app.use('/api/search', searchRouter)` to Source/Backend/src/app.ts. One-liner fix.

p1_findings.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read & Execution (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.description: Vitest <3.2.6 allows arbitrary file read and code execution when the Vitest UI server is listening. Affects Source/Frontend (v2.0.5) and portal/Backend (v1.2.0).
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: If the Vitest UI server is exposed on a reachable network interface during CI/CD or development, an attacker can read arbitrary files and execute code on the host.
p1_findings.impact: Critical if Vitest UI exposed; medium if strictly localhost dev-only use.
p1_findings.recommendation: Update vitest to >=3.2.6 in Source/Frontend and portal/Backend. Run: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest; cd portal/Backend && npm update vitest

p2_findings.title: pending_dependencies missing from WorkItemStatus enum
p2_findings.description: API contracts spec requires a 200 response with status=pending_dependencies when dispatch is blocked by unresolved dependencies. Implementation returns 400 instead. VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS has a comment claiming it but no implementation.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add pending_dependencies to WorkItemStatus enum, add transition rules to VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS, update route handler to return 200+status.

p2_findings.title: BlockedBadge missing amber state for pending_dependencies
p2_findings.description: Component only renders red badge or nothing. The amber branch for status='pending_dependencies' has no prop, no render path, and no test. Coupled to QO-002.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add amber badge variant after QO-002 enum fix. Add prop + render path + snapshot test.

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram absent from metrics
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 Prometheus metrics for dependency tracking. Only 3 are present — the timing histogram for readiness checks (dependencyCheckDuration) is missing.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add dependencyCheckDuration histogram to metrics.ts with appropriate buckets for ms-range operations.

p2_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal and FS Security Bypass (3 CVEs)
p2_findings.description: Vite ≤6.4.2 has path traversal in optimized deps .map handling, NTLMv2 hash disclosure on Windows, and server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths. Current version 5.4.0.
p2_findings.recommendation: Update vite to >=8.1.3 in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend.

p2_findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node Prometheus DoS (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: Malformed HTTP request to the Prometheus exporter endpoint causes the portal/Backend process to crash. Exploitable by any network-adjacent attacker. Current version 0.40.3, fix in >=0.75.0.

p2_findings.title: UUID buffer bounds check missing (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: uuid 9.0.0 is missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter is provided. Current version is 9.0.0; fix requires >=11.1.1 (or latest >=14.0.1).
p2_findings.recommendation: Update uuid to 14.0.1 in Source/Backend and platform/orchestrator.

p2_findings.title: pino 2 major versions behind (8 → 10)
p2_findings.description: pino is at 8.21.0, latest is 10.3.1. Two major versions behind means missing security patches, API improvements, and Node.js version support.
p2_findings.recommendation: Plan major version upgrade to pino 10.x with review of breaking changes in logging API.

p2_findings.title: react ecosystem 1 major version behind (18 → 19)
p2_findings.description: react, react-dom (18.3.1 → 19.2.7) and react-router-dom (6.30.4 → 7.18.1) are all one major version behind. These should be updated in lockstep.
p2_findings.recommendation: Plan React 19 upgrade sprint. Test all component rendering and hook behaviour. Update react-router-dom separately if API changes require it.

p2_findings.title: express 1 major version behind (4 → 5)
p2_findings.description: Express 4.22.2 in use, latest 5.2.1. Affects all three server packages. Express 5 has breaking API changes that require careful migration.
p2_findings.recommendation: Plan Express 5 migration. Review breaking changes (router, error handling, deprecated methods). Coordinate across all three backends.

p3_findings.title: Dual logger implementations — violates FR-003 dev pretty-printing
p3_findings.recommendation: Consolidate to single logger with dev/prod mode switch. Remove the compat shim.

p3_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to FR-dependency-* requirements
p3_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to include Specifications/Implementation/dependency-management.md (or equivalent) so FR-dependency-* defects are caught automatically.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable-next-line with no rationale comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Add a comment explaining why react-hooks/exhaustive-deps is suppressed, or fix the underlying hook dependency.

p3_findings.title: react-router-dom path handling CVE (Source/Frontend)
p3_findings.recommendation: Update react-router-dom to 7.x as part of React ecosystem upgrade sprint.

p3_findings.title: qs prototype pollution via express (transitive)
p3_findings.recommendation: Updating express to 5.x should resolve qs transitive vulnerability.

p3_findings.title: form-data CRLF injection via multipart field names
p3_findings.recommendation: Update form-data to >=4.0.6 in all affected manifests.

p3_findings.title: dockerode 1 major version behind (4 → 5)
p3_findings.recommendation: Plan dockerode 5 upgrade; review Docker API breaking changes.

p3_findings.title: multer 1 major version behind (1 → 2)
p3_findings.recommendation: Upgrade multer to 2.x with breaking change review.

p4_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md and tiered-merge-pipeline.md orphaned from traceability
p4_findings.description: These spec files target portal/ not Source/; not a defect but a documentation gap.

cross_references.single_fix: Configure Dependabot or Renovate to send weekly PRs for security patches and monthly PRs for minor/major upgrades. Immediate patches eliminate 6 CRITICAL CVEs.

cross_references.root_cause: pending_dependencies status not implemented across all layers
cross_references.single_fix: Add pending_dependencies to WorkItemStatus enum in Source/Shared/types/workflow.ts. BlockedBadge amber state, dispatch logic, and API response follow from that single enum change.
Consolidate to single logger (eliminate shim), add missing dependencyCheckDuration histogram. Both are in Source/Backend observability layer.

cross_references.root_cause: Traceability enforcer scope not expanded for FR-dependency-*
cross_references.single_fix: Update tools/traceability-enforcer.py to also scan FR-dependency-* requirements, and add traceability header to relevant spec files.
